description: This file defines a UI fragment for an Android TV app, specifically a HomeFragment that displays horizontally scrolling categories of recipes using the Leanback library. It includes a ViewModel for managing data which fetches categories and recipes from a RecipeRepository.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a horizontally scrolling list of recipe categories, each with recipes shown as cards. Uses Android TV Leanback library for a TV-friendly UI.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that loads recipe categories and corresponding recipes from a repository asynchronously and exposes them via LiveData.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets UI properties, and starts data observation.

methods.name: setupUI
methods.description: Configures the adapter and click listeners for the UI list.

methods.name: observeData
methods.description: Triggers data loading and observes for updates to display recipe categories and recipes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches categories and their recipes asynchronously, then posts the resulting list of ListRows to LiveData.
